profile.headline: Software Engineer | Distributed Systems, Data Infrastructure & AI/ML Platforms
profile.summary:
I'm a software engineer focused on building scalable infrastructure and platforms that power intelligent products.

At Apple, I've worked across large-scale Knowledge Graph infrastructure, data quality and analytics, privacy-aware data processing, and AI/ML systems. My work includes designing analytics pipelines for a knowledge graph containing billions of entities and facts, developing privacy redaction infrastructure for high-volume logging, and building data pipelines that connect ML-powered entity recognition to user-facing knowledge experiences.

More recently, I've focused on the infrastructure behind Question Answering models, including training data generation, human-in-the-loop annotation and grading workflows, and end-to-end evaluation pipelines that provide continuous feedback across model checkpoints.
I enjoy solving complex engineering problems that require strong system design, adaptability, and collaboration across engineering, product, ML, and UX teams. My experience spans foundational backend infrastructure and consumer-facing features, giving me a perspective on how reliable platforms translate into better product experiences.

I'm particularly interested in distributed systems, AI/ML infrastructure, and platform engineering that enables intelligent, user-centered products.
Always happy to connect with engineers and leaders working on scalable systems, AI infrastructure, and impactful software products.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led the design and implementation of analytics infrastructure for a Knowledge Graph containing billions of entities and facts, enabling leadership and product teams to track data quality, content coverage, and user engagement KPIs.
• Architected an offline Knowledge Graph quality evaluation pipeline that detects entity and fact violations against ontology rules, collaborating with ontologists to translate domain requirements into automated validation.
• Designed a privacy-aware log redaction solution using Bloom filters to enforce users' data-sharing preferences across logging infrastructure processing millions to billions of records daily.
• Built ML data infrastructure for Question Answering models, spanning training data generation, human-in-the-loop annotation and grading workflows, and extensible end-to-end evaluation across model checkpoints.
• Developed a distributed entity annotation pipeline processing millions of crawled webpages to identify entities and surface contextual knowledge cards, collaborating with ML and user experience teams.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Migrated production infrastructure from on-premises data centers to AWS, contributing to cloud modernization and improved infrastructure scalability.
• Developed enterprise authentication and identity-management solutions, including a SAML-based Single Sign-On portal with multi-factor authentication.
• Built features for an enterprise administration console, consulting directly with customers to translate operational requirements into product capabilities.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description: • Developed a customer-facing iOS application and vendor-facing iPad application for a food-ordering platform, implementing complementary ordering and vendor workflows.

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
• Extended cross-compilation support for Python and C on a research operating system for many-core architectures, enabling integration with third-party Python libraries.
• Implemented low-level CPU management features for Intel processors, enabling manual control of processor states.

positions.title: Quality Assurance Intern
positions.description: • Developed an automated testing framework for diverse payment transaction scenarios, supporting regression testing and validation of payment-processing workflows.

projects.title: Project Waitless
projects.description: Waitless is iOS application solution that smooths out the interaction between restaurant and customers.
